metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Relieve Stomach Pain (in 30 Seconds)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows at-home exercises that can help instantly relieve stomach pain.

If you’re dealing with stomach pain or a really bad upset stomach, definitely check this video out, as the exercises may help provide quick relief — even within 30 seconds.

These exercises are also perfect for constipation, trapped gas, and bloating — all major causes of stomach pain.

Each exercise works differently. To get the best results, go through all of them and use whichever gives you the most relief.

Watch now to instantly relieve an upset stomach and stomach pain!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:31 Gas Relieving Stretch
2:36 Modified Child's Pose
4:10 Twist and March
6:51 Cat–Cow (with Hip Circles)
8:35 Natural Pooing Position
